subtitle: Short domains that are still available
description:
Type a name and Domains tries the shorter versions of it: clipped forms, sound-alikes, initials, a dropped vowel, domain hacks and AI ideas, including real words from the same world. From harbour labs it finds harbr, quay and berth; from flicker, flickr. Names nobody could say are left out.

Every name is checked live with Namecheap, shortest first, and only the available ones show, as cards that settle in one after another. One row of ideas sits above them: tap one to see only its names, or ask for more like the ones you like.

Filters open from the search field in one compact panel: extensions, length, which ideas to make, and price. Tap a name for its first-year and renewal prices and a link to register it.

Star the good ones and collect them into lists, with a note. Sign in and share a list by link: whoever opens it sees every name on one page, checked again live, no account needed.
whatsNew: A calmer redesign. The search moves into the navbar, only available names show, and they arrive in a steady stream. One row of ideas replaces the long list, with an AI that also suggests words from the same world and a More like these round. Filters live in one compact panel. New: lists you can share by link, which open for anyone without signing in.
